props.gloss_en: one sold meat and it turned out to be firstborn meat, produce and it was tevel, wine and it was libation wine: what they ate, they ate, and he returns them the money
R' Shimon ben Elazar: things the soul finds repulsive -- he returns them the money
and things the soul does not find repulsive -- he deducts [their value] for them from the money
these are the things the soul finds repulsive: carcasses and tereifot, vermin and creeping things
these are the things the soul does not find repulsive: firstborns, tevel and libation wine
it is needed only where he sold him [meat] from the place of the blemish, so the seller says: had you not eaten it, I would have shown it and it would have been permitted to me
[that answer is] in accordance with R' Yehuda
tevel: [the seller says] I would have rectified it and eaten it
libation wine: [it is a case of libation wine sold] through a mixture
and [that answer is] in accordance with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel
libation wine that fell into a cistern: all of it is forbidden for benefit
RSbG: all of it may be sold to gentiles, except the value of the libation wine in it
